name: Residential Christmas Decorators
metaTitle: Residential Christmas Decorators | Ontario Holiday Décor
metaDescription: Full-service holiday decorating for homes across London Ontario and the GTA, wreaths, garlands and entrance décor added alongside your lighting install.
heroIntro: Wreaths, garlands, entrance décor and indoor trees, styled to match your home and installed alongside your lighting.
intro: Lights are only part of a finished holiday look. Our decorating service pairs with your roofline lighting to dress the rest of the property, wreaths on the front door and garage, garland along railings and porch posts, and coordinated colours that carry the theme from the street to your entryway. Because the same crew handles your lighting design, décor is planned together rather than added on as an afterthought, so the finished result reads as one cohesive display instead of mismatched pieces.

We work from a short consultation, either in person or from photos of your home, to figure out which touches make the biggest difference. A tired grapevine wreath from three seasons ago and mismatched bows never help a nicely lit roofline. When the season ends, our crew removes and packs the décor as part of takedown, the same way we handle your lights, so nothing gets left tangled in a bin in the garage.
included: Design consultation for wreaths, garlands and entrance décor
Wreaths for front doors, garage doors and windows
Garland for railings, porch posts and entryways
Coordinated bows and ribbon matched to your lighting colours
Installed alongside your roofline lighting in the same visit

sections.heading: How décor and lighting come together
sections.text: When you book residential decorating, we schedule it with your lighting installation rather than as a separate visit, since booking opens in late summer and installs run from early October through the first week of December. During the design step we talk through which parts of your home get the most attention from the street, usually the front door, garage, and any porch railings, and plan wreaths and garland to complement the colour and style of your roofline lighting. The result is a display that looks intentional rather than like lights were hung and décor was tacked on separately.

sections.heading: What drives the price
sections.text: Décor pricing depends on how many pieces you want, wreath size and quantity, the length of garland needed for railings or entryways, and whether you want indoor touches added on. A single front-door wreath is a small add-on to a lighting package, while full entrance styling with garland, bows and multiple wreaths is a larger scope. As with lighting, every quote is custom, and we confirm the full price before any work begins so you know exactly what the finished look will cost.

sections.heading: What to expect on installation day
sections.text: Our crew arrives with wreaths, garland and hardware already prepared based on your design consultation, so décor goes up efficiently alongside the lighting crew. We use hardware that will not mark your door, siding or railings, and we double check placement against the photos or in-person plan we discussed beforehand. If you decide mid-season that you would like an extra wreath or a different bow colour, let us know, we can usually accommodate small adjustments on our next visit to the area.

pricing: Decorating add-ons are priced individually and combined with your lighting package quote, so there is no separate fixed rate for wreaths and garland alone. Most homeowners bundle décor into a Festive or Griswold-tier lighting package, where typical residential jobs land between $700 and $3,500 total. Ask for a decorating add-on when you request your lighting quote and we will confirm the full cost together.

faq.q: Can I add decorating to my existing lighting package?
faq.a: Yes. Wreaths, garland and entrance décor are typically added on top of your lighting installation and scheduled in the same visit, so you get one coordinated look rather than two separate projects. One crew handles the whole job, from the design consultation through installation, mid-season upkeep and eventual takedown, so nothing falls through the cracks between vendors.

faq.q: Do you supply the wreaths and garland, or use pieces I already own?
faq.a: We can supply wreaths, garland and bows matched to your lighting colours, or work with pieces you already own if you would rather reuse decorations from previous years. Let us know your preference during the design consultation, either in person or from photos of your home, and we will plan the finished look around whichever option you choose.

faq.q: Will decorating damage my door, siding or railings?
faq.a: No. We use hardware specifically designed not to mark doors, garage panels or railings, the same property-safe approach we use for roofline lighting. Nothing is nailed, screwed or stapled into your home's exterior, so wreaths and garland come down at the end of the season without leaving holes or marks behind on your entryway.

faq.q: What happens to the décor once the season ends?
faq.a: It comes down as part of your lighting takedown, scheduled for January through early February depending on weather and safe access to your home. If you would rather not pack everything away in your garage yourself, ask about our year-round storage option, which keeps wreaths and garland cataloged and ready for next season.
